data_provenance: NTA JEE Main Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech) pattern as used in 2025–2026 sessions: 3 subjects × 25 questions, Section A 20 single-correct MCQs + Section B 5 numerical (all compulsory). Confirm against current NTA information bulletin before production use.
important_caveat: NTA can revise section counts or marking. Prefer seeded ExamPaperPattern documents when present; this file is the seed source for 2026 Paper 1.

exam_day.note: JEE Main Paper 1 is a single computer-based paper (Physics + Chemistry + Mathematics). Paper 2A/2B (Architecture/Planning) are separate and not seeded here.

question_types_note: JEE Main Paper 1 does NOT use multiple-correct or matrix-match; those are JEE Advanced-only.
